eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement scope reads 'Business and LAw'; Business maps to BUS and Law to GAPP at AUC.

eligible_majors.notes: Fact sheet p.3 notes Law exchange students may also take Business courses.

min_gpa_host.notes: KU 4.60 GPA threshold on kozminski.edu.pl applies to Rector scholarships for degree students; no incoming exchange GPA cutoff stated.

english_course_availability.notes: Dedicated English-taught term course lists published for Fall and Spring incoming exchange students.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Minimum B2 English required (FCE, IELTS, TOEFL, or official home-institution confirmation if current programme is taught in English; confirm RHET 1020 / English-medium confirmation).

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught courses; optional Polish for beginners available.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026 Fall (host term dates): late Sep 2025-late Jan/mid-Feb 2026 (exams). Note: AUC Excel specifies Spring and Academic Year.

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral partner exchange per Excel; AY 2025-2026 fact sheet does not explicitly state tuition waiver terms.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2025-2026 fact sheet p.4 monthly living breakdown: rent EUR 500-700 + food EUR 170-250 + local public transport EUR 13 + utilities EUR 100-150 = EUR 783-1,113/month. KU living-costs guide (https://www.kozminski.edu.pl/en/student-living-costs) also publishes Warsaw PLN item lines (shared room ~1,400-2,200 PLN, private dorms ~1,800-3,500 PLN, food 1,200-2,000 PLN, 30-day transit 60 PLN, utilities 500-1,200 PLN).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate from AY 2025-2026 fact sheet EUR monthly range midpoint: (EUR 783 + EUR 1,113) / 2 = EUR 948/month * 5 months = EUR 4,740 * 1.1052 USD/EUR (ECB reference rate ref 2026-11-13, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15) = USD 5,238.65 (approx. USD 5,239).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Non-EU students require valid medical/travel insurance covering minimum EUR 30,000.

housing_availability.notes: Off-campus housing only; KU shares private offers (x.alk.edu.pl) and partner platforms (Pepe Housing, Spotahome).

housing_notes.value: No university-owned dormitories; shared rooms ~1,400-2,200 PLN/mo, private dorms ~1,800-3,500 PLN/mo, utilities 500-1,200 PLN/mo per KU living guide (2+ room apartments 4,500-7,000 PLN/mo); AY 2025-2026 fact sheet p.4 notes EUR 500-700/mo rent.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Rector scholarships apply to regular degree students; no KU-funded stipend documented for non-EU incoming exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students staying >90 days require a Polish National Visa (even if holding another EU country's residence permit) plus EUR 30,000 medical insurance; exact consulate lead time and solvency amount not itemized.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Visa rule on p.4; EUR 30,000 insurance on p.3.

exchange_page_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Kozminski University/INCOMING PROCESS AT KU upd.pdf#page=1
exchange_page_url.notes: Also linked at https://www.kozminski.edu.pl/pl/spolecznosc/incoming-students in 2025-26 fact sheet p.3.

english_course_list_url.notes: Term-specific English course list PDFs (Fall/Spring) are distributed separately and filtered via https://www.kozminski.edu.pl/pl/spolecznosc/incoming-students and the syllabus portal.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; normal full-time load 30 ECTS/semester (maximum 35 ECTS).

course_restrictions_note.value: Undergraduate and graduate students may mix Bachelor and Master courses with home-institution approval; Law students may take Business courses as well.

value: Medical insurance proof (min EUR 30,000 for non-EU)
B2 English certificate or home-institution confirmation

city_tier.notes: Warsaw is Poland's capital city; schema city_tier label not explicitly categorized in fact sheet.

campus_type.notes: Located in Warsaw; physical campus layout category not explicitly stated in fact sheet.

international_support_services.value: KU Mate buddy programme, airport pickup, optional Polish language course for beginners, and KU International Society support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall / Academic Year: nomination May 1, application Jun 1; Spring: nomination Dec 1, application Jan 1.
